interpretation: Frozen mature S0 incremental probes; privileged rows are not deployable; no causal upper bound or from-scratch gain claim. Internal q0 is a shared frozen trained baseline here.

definitions.all_scenes: Every original primary-seed scene, including UNKNOWN and zero scores
definitions.checker_known_violation: Any original strict-checker known violation, independent of target eligibility
definitions.checker_road_or_kinematic: Original input has a known road or kinematic violation
definitions.dynamic_information_common_oracle_suppor: Actual query0 CV/FUT distance change >=1m or a supported overlap change, within the exact common oracle support; fixed before new rankings
definitions.incomplete_full_4s_support: Strict checker lacks whole-plan annotation support; local facts may still be valid
definitions.original_high_ge_0p9: Original common q0 canonical PDMS >=0.9; fixed before head rankings
definitions.original_low_le_0p5: Original common q0 canonical PDMS <=0.5; fixed before head rankings
definitions.sampled_known_overlap: Actual q0 has a reliable annotated-object overlap at a stored physical time
definitions.sampled_known_road_violation: Actual q0 has a reliable road violation at a stored physical time
definitions.strict_KEEP: Original strict teacher KEEP; scoped geometry, not a real-world safety certificate
definitions.strict_REPAIR: Original strict teacher REPAIR, before independent execution review
definitions.without_strict_target: No full-plan teacher target; not proof that the original plan has no error

limitations: Overlapping descriptive strata are not independent populations or extra hypothesis tests
CV/FUT share privileged support; a relationship change does not prove a necessary action change
Stored point support is not dense or full-trajectory certification
Strict REPAIR is a teacher status; independent execution admission remains a separate label
natural_input_group_evidence.selection: Original primary-seed input only; no final scores or head errors define groups

protocol.failure_policy: keep failed scenes at zero in all summaries and invalidate the benchmark
protocol.protocol: locked NAVSIM v1 full-reference-cache PDM; original 8 x 0.5s trajectory, 40 x 0.1s simulation

scope: Engineering only: 4 real training scenes, historical S0, 6 small-head updates; no efficacy conclusion
uncertainty: log-cluster resampling with original scene weights; sampling seeds and head seeds do not replicate the S0 foundation training seed
